items.title: Road closures around Karachi’s PIDC junction cause traffic congestion
items.description:
KARACHI: Commuters in Karachi’s Saddar area faced traffic congestion and inconvenience on Tuesday after authorities closed some roads around the PIDC junction in response to a sit-in call by the Sindh Indus Lawyers Forum (SILF).
In an alert issued at 1:16pm, Karachi Traffic Police said both roads from PIDC Chowk towards the State Life Building, as well as Dr Ziauddin Ahmed Road, were closed to traffic.
As an alternative route, traffic was diverted from PIDC Chowk towards Club Road and from the State Life Building towards Beaumont Road.

items.description:

items.description:

It is the first time Hasina, 79, has set a specific date for her return, potentially raising political and legal tensions in a country where her party is banned and where violence has risen since she sought a new passport and other documents earlier this month.

items.description:

items.description:
